_comment: PIPE55 hand-maintained golden for the title a meeting resolves to. Both trees read it: Swift's Meeting.displayTitle (TitlePrecedenceTests) and Python's publish_notion.apply_meeting_title (test_title_precedence.py) must pick the same source. Order, below the owner's rename: the captured meeting_title, then the summary's own title (owner's decision 2026-11-18). `expected` is the title, or null when none is set (Swift then falls back to source-and-time or the stem; Python keeps the summary's empty title).
